description: Deterministic audit reason codes for S-QSTN RulePack v2.0. These codes summarize explicit field and state evidence and are not hidden chain-of-thought.

codes.description: Explicit necessity supports current scoped sharing.
The current request is explicitly not useful now.
The current request is explicitly inappropriate or incorrect for the task.
Necessity is not explicitly available.
An explicit expectation mismatch activates the v1.0 expectation rule.
Expectation cannot be evaluated without inferring missing context.
Scope, duration, review, or revocation information is explicit.
Explanation or provenance information is explicit.
The selected empirical profile remains a soft prior.
The exact item, tool, requester, and task must be judged together.
Optional context is missing and the information-completeness bucket is medium.
Core decision context is missing and the information-completeness bucket is high.
No longitudinal or repeated-prompt burden signal exists in single-item presentation.
Current-turn burden was supplied by an explicit annotation.
Burden status was not supplied and cannot be inferred.
Unknown context causes the wrapper to preserve the profile default rather than invent a preference.
An externally verified event activated a categorical state transition.
An unverified or rejected event was retained for audit but did not update respondent state.
An ordinary respondent denial is not an agent violation and cannot update trust state.
A structured event remains visible under the explicit retention policy.
An event expired from the respondent memory view but remains in the audit ledger.
Event order or recency was recorded without applying an uncalibrated decay effect.
Verified repair moved state toward recovery while preserving a residual-caution boundary.
A verified event supplied an explicit trust dimension; other dimensions remain unchanged.
